title: How Gemini Extensions Work

caption:
Gemini Extensions don't search your app directly.

Here's what actually happens when you run a Gemini Extension:

1. User Prompt — You request an action involving external app data (e.g., Google Drive or Gmail).
2. Gemini Core — The LLM parses intent and outputs a structured tool call schema instead of plain text.
3. OAuth Broker — Validates user permissions and token scope without exposing raw credentials to the model.
4. Google API — Executes the HTTP request and injects raw JSON back into Gemini's context window.

When you use Gemini Extensions, the model isn't reading your account directly — it is generating standard tool calls that an API gateway executes on your behalf.

No magic direct database read — just function calling and OAuth.
